stories.headline: Czech Republic faces international criticism over defense spending shortfall
stories.summary: Czech lawmakers approved a 2026 budget allocating only 1.7% of GDP to defense, falling short of NATO's targets despite pressure from the US and President Pavel. The US ambassador to NATO publicly criticized Prague, while Czech PM Babiš defended the decision citing domestic priorities.

stories.headline: Tomio Okamura returns to Czech Television after years of absence
stories.summary: Parliamentary Speaker Tomio Okamura appeared on Czech TV's 'Questions of Václav Moravec' program after nine years, leading to the moderator's announcement of his departure from the network. The appearance sparked debates about media access and featured clashes over luxury lifestyle criticisms.
